title: Pay and schedule of the Hollywood Palace and other TV shows
summary: Edison explains TV pay compared with life on the road with Basie, his rehearsal hours and the other shows he worked.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Apart from the security of it, how well would that pay, compared with --
-- I mean, better than being with Basie or --

When you consider your rent and your food and your living expenses on the road, whatever that you would make here would be more than what you would make on the road with Basie. And you're at home, too, see?
So -- well, for two days, I'd make about $400.00.

Well, to tape the show and rehearse would be -- we would do that on Thursday. We'd go on about 2:00 in the afternoon. We'd get out around eight, nine at night. That was rehearsal. Then the next day, we would have to be there -- well, it depended on how much music that we had to play. Then if we had to play a long show, we'd have to be there around nine in the morning and we wouldn't get out until after the show that night, which would be about seven or eight o'clock. That was all day.
Well, what did you do the rest of the week?
Well, I'd record. I had record dates, you know.
But I mean basically, this show would give you two good days (inaudible).
Well, that wasn't bad because you got one record date and you've got --
Oh, I recorded just about every day, you know? Every day I'd have a record date someplace, you know, and --
Even if you didn't, I mean, it gave you

Sure. But then I would do record dates all the time. Then I started doing the -- I did the Della Reese Show for a year. Then I did the Frank Sinatra Show -- he had a show at one time. And Rosemary Clooney did two years of shows, Roosemary Clooney Show. Then with Nelson. Then I did the Bill Cosby Show. I did Leslie Uggams Show. I did the Don Knotts Show. I did the Don Rickles Show.
